tools.description: Produce and independently check a finite exact certificate for the supplied matrix: RREF, rational rank, complete rational nullspace basis and determinant (null for nonsquare matrices). Output includes explicit shapes, invertible row-operation trace and row transform. Acceptance verifies only this matrix, not a formal proof. Input must be canonical exact JSON, never floating-point or source expressions. Only one explicit matrix over Q, including Z-input coefficients; no integer-lattice basis, symbolic parameters, generic rank, geometric identification or family theorem. At most 16 rows/columns, 256 cells per matrix, 128-bit input coefficient components, 2048-bit stored intermediate/certificate components, 1024 row operations and 2000000 charged work units per stage. Exact arithmetic/resource rejection is not a negative mathematical verdict. Bridge frames remain limited to 65536 input bytes, 1048576 output bytes and 16384 JSON nodes; a standalone-valid certificate can be too large to check through this bridge. No caller-specified limits, paths, code or commands. No Lean or independent proof-kernel check; no runtime goal acceptance. Hashes bind content, not authenticity.

Schema conformance alone never verifies a certificate.
